subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting now, or defer user-dimensional billing/quota reporting until broader Gateway principal work lands?
rationale: Current usage data has session, origin, agent, and provider metadata, but no canonical per-user identity or permission boundary for billing-grade views.

options.title: Define accounting subject first
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved identity and viewer-permission contract before implementing user usage aggregates in the RPCs/UI.

options.title: Defer to principal work
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until Gateway principal/authorship design settles.

options.title: External dashboard only for now
options.body: Document current usage exports and plugin/Prometheus surfaces as the supported workaround until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define accounting subject first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved identity and viewer-permission contract before implementing user usage aggregates in the RPCs/UI.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across provider usage tracking, `/usage` cost summaries, and usage RPC/UI maintenance.
